|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[General Dodonna (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “While at a Rebel Base during your control phase, may use 1 Force: ▲any Rebel pilot of ability < 3, Colonel Feyn Gospic, or an Admiral's Order.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During your control phase, if at a Rebel Base location, may use 1 Force to take one Colonel Feyn Gospic, an Admiral’s Order, or a Rebel pilot of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “While” → “During your control phase, if”; “during your control phase,” → “location,”; “Force: ▲any” → “Force to take one Colonel Feyn Gospic, an Admiral’s Order, or a”; “3, Colonel Feyn Gospic, or an Admiral's Order.” → “3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 07. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[General Dodonna]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[General Dodonna (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[General Dodonna]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_7.
